description: The depositor thoulihan supplies a three-dimensional representation of Vernon Pumping Station off Wyman Park Drive in Baltimore, United States. Zenodo identifies the source as Objaverse 1.0 and Sketchfab and provides a GLB mesh with JPEG thumbnails under CC BY 4.0. The deposited description identifies the masonry pumping-station building constructed in 1931; the record is dated May 2021. The mesh could supply exterior geometry for a visual digital twin or an inspection-simulation scene. It does not establish pump characteristics, pipe connectivity or hydraulic performance. Survey date, physical scale, coordinate reference and geometric accuracy remain unknown, and the historical description does not verify current operating status. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this individual asset mesh. Only the public description and file inventory were checked; the mesh was not downloaded or measured.
